title: Conformal oxides decouple chemical stability and energetics at NiO x /perovskite interfaces
title_zh: 共形氧化物在 NiO<sub>x</sub>/钙钛矿界面上解耦化学稳定性与能量学
abstract: Nickel oxide (NiO x ) is a common hole transport layer (HTL) in perovskite photovoltaics, but the chemical reactivity of NiOx surfaces accelerates degradation when contacting perovskites. We developed an ultrathin, conformal tin oxide (SnO x ) interlayer to suppress interfacial reactivity between NiO x and perovskite. SnO x is typically an electron transport layer, but we show that the energy alignment can be modified for hole extraction using molecules with dipoles. This synergy yielded high efficiency in perovskite photovoltaic devices and showed an ~10x improvement in T 90 lifetime in open-circuit conditions under AM1.5G at 65°C. This structure also improves resilience to thermomechanical durability, as minimodules retained 95.7% of their initial performance after 1000 thermal cycles (−65° to 85°C), highlighting the importance of interfaces for robust perovskite photovoltaic modules.
abstract_zh: 镍氧化物（NiO<sub>x</sub>）是钙钛矿光伏中常见的空穴传输层（HTL），但 NiO<sub>x</sub> 表面的化学活性会在与钙钛矿接触时加速降解。我们开发了一种超薄共形锡氧化物（SnO<sub>x</sub>）中间层，以抑制 NiO<sub>x</sub> 与钙钛矿之间的界面反应。SnO<sub>x</sub> 通常是电子传输层，但我们展示了通过使用具有偶极分子的分子可以修改能量对齐以实现空穴提取。这种协同作用在钙钛矿光伏器件中产生了高效率，并在 AM1.5G 65 °C 开路条件下实现了 T<sub>90</sub> 寿命约提升 10 倍。该结构还提高了热机械耐久性，微模块在 1000 次热循环（-65 °C 至 85 °C）后仍保持 95.7 % 的初始性能，凸显了界面在实现稳健钙钛矿光伏模块中的重要性。
